title: The Power of the Fate Scribe
next_chapter_hook: The commander of the dimensional invaders issued an ultimatum: within three breaths, Chen Ji must make a choice—whether to accept the fate of becoming a bridge, or to wage war directly with the power of the Fate Scribe?

text.content: The will of all beings surged into the Mental Sea like a flood. Chen Ji felt his soul being woven by countless threads of light—each ray was a heartbeat of a living being, and every beat carried a thousand-year longing. The blurry figure finally became clear—the face so familiar it stopped his heart, was gazing at him with tears in its eyes. "Brother... you finally came for me." Chen Ling's voice was no longer the childish tone from his memories, but a calmness after all the hardships, yet still retaining its unique gentle arc.

Chen Ji's throat tightened. How many years had it been? He thought he had buried that guilt deep within the deepest corner of the chess game, wrapping it layer upon layer with coldness and calculation, only to have all his defenses shattered by a single glance from her. Chen Ling looked even more haggard than he had imagined—the experiments the Holy Sect conducted on the Heavenly Fate Key left faint gray patterns on her brow center, scars left behind after spiritual energy was forcibly extracted. "I'm sorry..." Chen Ji opened his mouth. These three words he had owed for a full ten years.

Chen Ling gently shook her head, the gray patterns on her brow flickering slightly with her emotional fluctuation: "Brother has nothing to apologize for. I was the one who disrupted your chess game, wasn't I?" Her smile carried a hint of mischief, "I can feel... when your Tianji Record saw me, the foresight became blurry." Chen Ji was shaken in his heart—she indeed knew. Knew that her existence would interfere with the calculations of fate, knew that she herself was the only variable in his otherwise flawless plans.

dialogue.content: "The Holy Sect kept me in the 'Heavenly Fate Cauldron,' extracting my connection to the Heavenly Way every day." Chen Ling's voice was very calm, calmly enough to make one's heart ache, "They said that as long as they completely refined me, they could create a tool to replace the Heavenly Will. But they don't know... I've been waiting for you all along." Her finger gently touched Chen Ji's brow center, and a wisp of warm power spread from the point of contact, "Because only you can set me truly free."

text.content: Two wisps of soul met in the Mental Sea, like rivers separated for years finally flowing back into the same sea. Chen Ji felt fragments of Chen Ling's memories flooding in like a tide—the dark prison cells, the endless experiments, and his name repeatedly murmured in the depths of despair. He tightly grasped her hand, once so soft, now covered with tiny scars. "From now on," his voice low and firm, "no one will ever be able to hurt you."

Just then, a cold, sinister laughter echoed from the depths of the Mental Sea. The will of the Heavenly Eye coiled up like a venomous snake: "Touching reunion. Unfortunately, your so-called Fourth Path is merely another prison." Chen Ji felt that familiar oppressive sensation descend once more, more powerful than ever before—the commander of the dimensional invaders had completed some form of fusion with the Heavenly Eye, a transcendent existence closing in on them.

dialogue.content: "The essence of the Fourth Path is not replacement, but connection." Chen Ling's voice suddenly became solemn, the gray patterns on her brow beginning to emit a soft golden light, "Between Heaven and all beings, a bridge is needed—not a ruler, not a puppet, but a translator." She looked at Chen Ji, determination blazing in her eyes, "This is the true power of the Fate Scribe: not to write destiny, but to let Heaven hear the voices of all beings."

text.content: The fragmented pages of the Tianji Record violently trembled in the Mental Sea, and the fourth page's seal finally shattered. Mo Xiansheng's remnant soul emerged from the text, carrying unprecedented solemnity: "Master, the time for fusion has arrived. However, this requires both of you siblings to completely open your souls, without reservation." His voice trembled slightly, "This means... everything will be shared. Including pain, including memories, including... destiny."

dialogue.content: Su Qingyao's voice suddenly pierced through from the outside world, carrying suppressed urgency: "Chen Ji! I sense your Heavenly Fate Value plummeting—are you insane?!" Her silhouette flickered at the edge of the Mental Sea, her consciousness desperately trying to penetrate inward, "What are you doing?!" Chen Ji felt her worry cut his heart like a blade, yet it also gave him the courage for absolute resolve—he already had someone worth protecting, and he could not fall here.

text.content: Chen Ji drew a deep breath and looked at Chen Ling. Those eyes reflected his own image, as well as the fate of the entire Three Realms. "I choose to trust you." His voice was soft, yet heavy as Mount Tai. The moment the words fell, he proactively released all defenses of the Mental Sea, laying bare all his calculations, guilt, tenderness, and madness from the past ten years before her. Chen Ling's eyes reddened, and she likewise opened her soul. Two beams of light began to intertwine and coil—the complete power of the Fate Scribe was awakening.

However, the fusion was not without cost. As the two souls converged, Chen Ji felt an intense pain explode from his brow center—Chen Ling's control inscriptions implanted by the Holy Sect were frantically counterattacking, trying to prevent the fusion's completion. The Heavenly Eye's laughter grew more triumphant: "See? This is the consequence of betraying me! You both will be incinerated to ashes in the Heavenly Fate Cauldron!" Su Qingyao screamed externally, sensing Chen Ji's Heavenly Fate Value draining at an alarming rate.

choice.prompt: The fusion fell into crisis—Chen Ling's control inscriptions were tearing their souls apart, while the Heavenly Eye awaited their failure. Chen Ji had to make a choice within three breaths:

choices.text: Forcefully break the inscriptions with his own Heavenly Fate Value
choices.description: Burn his own Heavenly Fate Value, using the Fate Scribe's primal power to forcibly destroy Chen Ling's control inscriptions. This would reduce Chen Ji's Heavenly Fate Value to zero and cause Heavenly Fate backlash.
choices.visible_reward: Inscriptions broken, Chen Ling gains freedom
choices.risk_hint: After Heavenly Fate Value reaches zero, Heavenly backlash will descend

text.content: Chen Ji unhesitatingly poured all his Heavenly Fate Value into the bridge of fusion. Golden light wrapped around the gray patterns on Chen Ling like fierce flames, and the inscriptions let out a shrill wail before shattering into fragments. "Brother!" Chen Ling watched him in horror, because at this moment, she felt her brother's soul being burned by Heavenly Fate backlash.

dialogue.content: "Chen Ji! Don't!" Su Qingyao's voice tore through the boundary of the Mental Sea, her figure rushing in without hesitation, hands pressing down on Chen Ji's shoulders—the shared fate buff automatically triggered—she wanted to share the backlash for him! Chen Ji felt that familiar warmth coming from the direction of the Tianqing Sect, his eyes suddenly moistening.

choices.text: Let Chen Ling destroy the inscriptions with her own will
choices.description: Without forcibly intervening, guide Chen Ling to actively break free using the will she forged through years of imprisonment. This requires Chen Ling to endure all the pain, but will not drain Chen Ji's Heavenly Fate Value.
choices.visible_cost: Chen Ling will endure the inscription backlash
choices.visible_reward: Chen Ling gains complete control over her power
choices.risk_hint: Chen Ling's consciousness may collapse during the process

text.content: Chen Ji did not act on her behalf, but instead gathered his strength into a warm support that gently encircled Chen Ling. "You can do it." His voice was soft, yet filled with absolute trust. Chen Ling's eyes reddened; she gritted her teeth and transformed all the hatred and unwillingness accumulated during her ten-year imprisonment into blades, slicing away the restraints on her body piece by piece. Excruciating pain made her body tremble violently, but she did not let out a single moan.

dialogue.content: "Watch me, brother." Chen Ling's voice trembled with pain, but her eyes burned brighter than ever before. "These ten years were not endured in vain!" As her words fell, the gray patterns shattered like broken mirrors, and the light at her Brow Center transformed from gray to pure gold. The full power of the Fate Scribe had truly awakened at this moment.

choices.text: Mobilize the will of all beings to directly confront the restraints
choices.description: Using the will of all beings that had just flooded into the Mental Sea, employing the faith of the three realms' beings to counter the Holy Sect's restraints. This was the first practice of the Fate Scribe as a bridge, but would consume the power of the will of all beings.
choices.visible_cost: The will of all beings is temporarily weakened
choices.visible_reward: Display the true power of the Fate Scribe: connecting Heavenly Mandate and all beings
choices.risk_hint: Heavenly Eye may take the opportunity to interfere

text.content: Chen Ji formed seals with both hands, and the will of all beings in his Mental Sea surged toward Chen Ling like summoned raging waves. Countless points of light gathered into a magnificent torrent, representing the expectations and faith of the three realms' beings accumulated over thousands of years. When this force collided with the restraints, the Holy Sect's methods seemed so insignificant—the restraints were not destroyed, but were "politely invited" away from Chen Ling by the faith of all beings.

dialogue.content: Heavenly Eye let out an enraged roar: "This is impossible! How dare you... use the will of these lowly creatures to oppose my laws!" But what Chen Ji felt was not fear, but a strange calm. He finally understood the meaning of the fourth path—not to replace Heavenly Mandate, but to make it hear the voices it has always ignored.

text.content: The moment the restraints collapsed, the full power of the Fate Scribe bloomed like the sun in the Mental Sea of both Chen Ji and Chen Ling. It was no longer the vague runes on the fragment, but a true brush—with a body condensed from the faith of all beings, and a tip dipped in the ink of Heavenly Mandate. The moment Chen Ji grasped it, countless visions flooded into his mind: he saw the past, the future, every chess piece Heavenly Eye had positioned, and the fourth path that no one had ever walked.

Su Qingyao's figure rushed before them, her face pale as paper—the shared destiny buff had her share part of the backlash, yet there was not a trace of blame in her eyes when she looked at Chen Ji, only deep-seated worry and pride. "You..." Her voice choked. "Jerk." Chen Ji offered her a weak but sincere smile, reaching out to brush away the tear at the corner of her eye. At this moment, he was no longer the meticulous chess master, but simply a person who loved and was loved.

dialogue.content: "Thank you, brother." Chen Ling gently held the hands of Chen Ji and Su Qingyao, the powers of three people converging at this moment. "And sister-in-law." Su Qingyao's face flushed completely red, but she did not deny it. Chen Ling's smile carried the first real happiness in ten years: "Now, we should go tell Heavenly Eye that its era of dominating the three realms... is over." Her gaze suddenly turned sharp, looking toward that terrifying aura approaching from beyond the Mental Sea.

choice.prompt: The commander of the dimensional invaders has arrived at the edge of the three realms, its will merging with Heavenly Eye to form a transcendent existence. It issues a final ultimatum—within three breaths, Chen Ji must make his ultimate choice:

choices.text: Initiate dialogue as the Fate Scribe
choices.description: As a bridge between Heavenly Mandate and all beings, use the Brush of Fate to write the first truly mutual-benefit contract. This is a huge gamble—Heavenly Eye may accept, or it may directly annihilate this "traitor".
choices.visible_cost: May be eliminated as a threat
choices.visible_reward: Initiate a brand new order for the three realms

text.content: Chen Ji slowly raised the Brush of Fate, the faith of all beings on its body beginning to flow, transforming into a line of brilliant text that appeared across the sky of the three realms: "Heavenly Mandate is merciless, all beings possess spirits, only bridges connect." In that moment, every living being in the three realms saw this line of text, their faith surging into Chen Ji's body like a tide, becoming his greatest support.

dialogue.content: Heavenly Eye's voice thundered across the three realms: "Bridge? You are merely an ant. By what right do you speak to me!" Yet in its threatening voice, for the first time, there was a tremor—it felt the power of all beings, a power it had oppressed for billions of years, awakening within Chen Ji.

choices.text: Unleash the full power of the Fate Scribe to start a direct war
choices.description: No more negotiation, use the power just awakened to face Heavenly Eye in direct confrontation. This is a gamble with no retreat—win, and the three realms gain freedom; lose, and it is utter destruction.
choices.visible_cost: The three realms may be destroyed as a result
choices.risk_hint: The power has not yet been fully mastered.

text.content: Chen Ji raised the Destiny Pen high, its tip pointing toward the dark Void representing the Celestial Eye: "I, Chen Ji, have cultivated to this day without ever fearing any existence." His voice echoed through the Three Realms, carrying indomitable majesty. "Today, let this Destiny Pen inscribe your verdict of abdication!" The words fell, and he and Chen Ling发力 simultaneously, as all the power of the Fate Writer surged toward the Celestial Eye like a river of stars inverted.

The moment Chen Ji made his choice, an even more terrifying aura erupted from the dimensional rift. The commander of the dimensional invaders finally revealed itself—a massive humanoid form composed of countless twisted realities, its every inch tearing apart the laws of the Three Realms. "Foolish creatures of the Three Realms," its voice was like ten thousand blades cutting simultaneously, "before true eternity, your struggles are meaningless." The Celestial Eye's voice intertwined with it, forming a dual oppression: "Chen Ji, you have only one chance—submit, or be destroyed."

dialogue.content: Chen Ji stood in the radiance condensing around the Destiny Pen, watching that transcendent existence slowly approach. His palms were slightly damp, yet a familiar cold smirk curled his lips: "Submit?" His voice was soft, yet carried biting mockery. "I, Chen Ji, have never learned how to write those two characters in this lifetime." He turned to Su Qingyao and Chen Ling, their gazes meeting as their minds synchronized without a word. "However—" he turned back to the terrifying presence, his eyes glinting with calculated cunning, "before we fight, I'd like to ask: do you know what it means to 'play dumb to eat the tiger'?

text.content: The dimensional invaders' commander bellowed in fury, shattering several surrounding dimensions: the dignity of Heaven cannot be profaned! Yet its rage played perfectly into Chen Ji's hands—the moment this terrifying existence was distracted, hidden formations across the Three Realms blazed to life simultaneously. Han Lie's Xuanwu Battle Formation, Ling Yuan's Forbidden Technique Seals, even the rebellious forces within the Holy Sect—all of Chen Ji's dark pieces positioned over the years ignited at once. "Did you think I came to die?" Chen Ji laughed heartily, "No, I've come to collect the web!"

The sky of the Three Realms was torn apart by countless beams of light, the prelude to war sounding at this moment. Chen Ji gripped the Destiny Pen, standing at the storm's center, feeling the power of all beings surge into his body like a rising tide. He knew the true decisive battle had just begun—but no matter what lay ahead, he was no longer alone. Chen Ling stood at his left, Su Qingyao at his right, countless comrades assembling behind them. This time, he was not a solitary chess player, but a leader guiding all beings to resist Heaven's tyranny. The pen of destiny now rested firmly in his hands.
